items.note: The PRD is generic. It says it has no product details, never mentions note-taking, and even asks whether the product is B2B or consumer.
Nothing is aimed at engineering and design leads or framed for a kickoff. It's a general all-audience PRD.
It covers workspace creation and email invites, but 'shared notes' becomes generic 'resources'. v1 is also padded with billing, migration, invite links and more.
It defines four roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer/Guest) instead of only admin and member.
SSO is a non-goal, but billing changes are in v1 scope (section 6.6, P0 workspace billing) and guest/viewer access is included.
The metric is '% of active users in ≥1 workspace: 20% at 90 days'. It should be 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days.
The document has 15 sections plus tables, far longer than about 2 pages.
Migration is a P0 requirement (6.4) with a rollout plan, not an open question. It isn't listed in the Open Questions section.
